name: Greek Chicken Pasta Salad with Tomato, Bell Pepper, Parsley & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place chicken in another large bowl along with ⅓ of the dressing; turn to coat. (Reserve bowl with remaining dressing for the salad.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and mince onion. Add to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
Trim and large dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes crosswise and add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl, along with the feta, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and top with sliced chicken. Enjoy!
